notes.title: Fallen Empires now available!!
notes.notes: Download Fallen Empires today! Battle it out in campaign or against kingdoms across the globe.  Upgrade your armies and conquer kingdoms across the land. For an added twist, try your luck against a horde of zombie knights. Will you join us your highness?

notes.title: Fallen Empires will release in 5 days!
notes.notes:
Play Fallen Empires on sale September 30! Last minute testers still needed - comment below to join the beta.

Online multiplayer servers already live. Join the multiplayer launch event TBA.

notes.title: New Trailer Added
notes.notes: Check it out on the store page! Demos new updates and 4k support.

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Added
notes.notes: Fallen Empires will now feature online multiplayer just in time for release! Battle kingdoms across the globe and rise to the top of the multiplayer leaderboard. New trailer coming soon.

notes.title: Private Beta and New Content
notes.notes:
[h1]Beta[/h1]
The Fallen Empires private beta is now active. Please message lightningmanmedia on Steam to receive your beta key. 

[h1]New Content[/h1]
There will be a new trailer coming soon demoing some in-game improvements. Steam leaderboards, weekly community events, and lots of new features coming before and after launch. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update on Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Due to unforeseen circumstances in the development process, the game's release date will be pushed back until later this summer.

We want to provide you with the best possible product, and will require more time to ensure the gameplay is the best it can be.

If don't want to wait and you're interested in playing the pre-release beta version, please comment below and I will send you a beta key when available.

I thank you all very much for your patience and interest. 
 
-Chris

Lead Developer
